scope: Local fixed saved task-view definitions and current-state evaluation; no live tests or deployment

checks.name: Release application and all three Worker dry builds
Neutral query cases and invalid portable definitions
Changed prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: Optional SavedTaskViews retain globally unique identities, revision, name, archive state and fixed source/filter definitions. Missing/null collections preserve unused serialization and explicit empty remains explicit.

Both runtimes reject unknown sources/predicates, pagination in definitions, incompatible stage/state or candidate overrides, invalid names/ranges/references, duplicate IDs, future revisions and fabricated effect fields. Retained archived category/project/label references remain valid.

Evaluators reuse current task/candidate semantics with no cached result IDs, immutable predicates and caller paging only. Missing/archived views and stale continuation fail; current state changes immediately affect results without changing saved definitions.
Scoped IndexedDB, portable journal backup and frozen authority transfer retain saved definitions; no D1 migration, task activity or game effect is introduced.
limitations: Reviewed authoring commands, transport tools, relative presets, optional reminders and production saved-list controls remain separate units.
No real host, device, account or gameplay qualification and no deployment.
